t: #3144 Minimum Substring Partition of Equal Character Frequency
o: **Understanding the problem**: Split s into consecutive parts where each part is "balanced": every distinct character in it occurs the same number of times (single characters are trivially balanced). Minimize the number of parts. Example 1: "fabccddg" → 3 (e.g., "fab","ccdd","g"). Example 2: "abababaccddb" → 2 ("abab", "abaccddb"). With n ≤ 1000, an O(n²) DP checking balance incrementally fits easily: dp[i] = 1 + min over balanced s[j..i−1] of dp[j].
k: A window s[l..r) is balanced iff maxCount × distinctChars == window length.
Extending the window one character right updates count, max, and distinct in O(1), so all windows ending at i are checked in O(n) — overall O(n²).

a.n: Approach 1: Left-to-right DP with incremental balance check
a.i: dp[i] = minimum parts for prefix of length i. For each i, grow the last part backwards from i−1, maintaining counts; whenever the balance invariant holds, relax dp[i] with dp[start] + 1.
s: For each end i, reset counts and scan start from i−1 down to 0, adding s[start] to the counts and updating max/distinct.
If maxCount × distinct == (i − start), set dp[i] = min(dp[i], dp[start] + 1).
a.t: O(n²) — for each of n endings, the backward extension performs O(1) work per step
a.sp: O(n) — DP array plus a 26-slot count buffer

a.i: Same recurrence written recursively: best(i) = min over balanced suffix-windows s[i..k) of 1 + best(k). Memoization over i keeps it O(n²) and mirrors how many people naturally think about partitioning.
s: For position i, grow k from i forward maintaining counts; whenever balanced, relax best(i) with 1 + best(k).
a.t: O(n²) — each start position extends at most n characters with O(1) updates

w: **Wrap-up**: The invariant maxCount × distinct == length is the crux — internalize it, and the DP writes itself. Pitfalls: single characters count as balanced (distinct = 1, max = 1 ✓), and resetting counts per ending position (forgetting this corrupts the balance test). Follow-ups: partition into balanced parts with each character count exactly k, or maximize the number of parts instead.
